items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I wrote a thing for Trummy Young to sing on our theater tour... Trummy Young was on the band.

ctx.x: Nothing that has survived into this library?
There was a thing--I wrote a thing for Trummy Young to sing on our theater tour, which was "Is You Is Or Is You Ain't My Baby"; I recall that one.
I imagine there were a whole bunch of nondescript pop tunes, publisher's material that came through in the early days that I wrote, but I don't really remember those things.

items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: He had a piano player that wrote real good. His name was John Handy -- George Handy. George was an arranger on that band.

ctx.x: Did you record with them? (inaudible)? Or you didn't record with Boyd Raeburn?

No. I didn't record with Raeburn. No, I didn't -- I didn't record with Raeburn. I played a few jobs with him, though, you know. He had a piano player that wrote real good. His name was John Handy -- George Handy.
